permissions.comment: http://localhost is the sandbox preview origin. https://* is required by MCP OAuth and by every external link in the app, both of which reach the OS because window.open returns null in a webview: an authorize URL belongs to whatever authorization server a connection's MCP server advertises, so the set is open-ended and cannot be enumerated ahead of time. vscode/cursor back the Open in editor buttons. Plaintext http beyond loopback stays denied — an authorize URL served over it would be a downgrade.
